with t as (
 select p.market_ticker mt, p.strategy, p.created_at, p.assumed_price px, p.quantity q, p.pnl, p.status, p.side, p.resolved_value rv, s.close_time
 from paper_trades p left join mmsell_settlement_meta s on s.market_ticker=p.market_ticker
 where p.market_ticker like 'KXRAIN-%' and p.strategy like '%mmsell%' and p.status in ('settled','closed_sl')
)
select mt, min(side) side, min(created_at) first_entry, max(close_time) close_time,
 round(extract(epoch from max(close_time)-min(created_at))/3600,1) htc_first,
 round(avg(px),1) px, max(rv) rv, count(*) n, count(*) filter (where pnl<0) n_loss,
 string_agg(distinct status,',') statuses, round(sum(pnl),2) pnl
from t group by mt having count(*) filter (where pnl<0)>0 order by first_entry
